scope: Same five common DOCX inputs plus the two-column body-list fixture; alternating five fresh processes before/after with the same interpreter/dependencies. No concurrent full tests or PDF validation during timing. No general speed/RSS claim.

memory.scope: Actual _cell_lines layout, 1000/10000 explicit lines, alternating three fresh processes per version. Fonts and input model registered before tracemalloc; counts, text, source-model preservation and dataclasses.replace checked. Only Python allocations during layout, not full RSS, native font allocations, conversion time or PDF size.
memory.object_size_note: getsizeof diagnostics run after tracemalloc stops; accessing __dict__ may materialize managed dictionaries. Do not sum these diagnostics to infer retained layout allocations.
memory.worker_source:
import gc,json,sys,tracemalloc
from contextlib import ExitStack
from dataclasses import replace
from fpdf import FPDF
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer.font import close_fonts,register_fonts
count=int(sys.argv[1]);writer=LdmPdfWriter()
cell=ldm.Cell(paragraphs=[ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.Run(text='\n'.join(f'LINE{i:05}' for i in range(count)),font=ldm.Font(size=9))])])
snapshot=cell.model_dump();pdf=FPDF();register_fonts(pdf);pdf.add_page()
with ExitStack() as cleanup:
 cleanup.callback(close_fonts,pdf)
 gc.collect();tracemalloc.start()
 lines=writer._table_renderer._cell_lines(pdf,cell,100)
 current,peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory();tracemalloc.stop()
 assert len(lines)==count and cell.model_dump()==snapshot
 assert [line.segments[0][1] for line in lines]==[f'LINE{i:05}' for i in range(count)]
 clone=replace(lines[0],height=lines[0].height/2);assert clone.height==lines[0].height/2 and clone.segments is lines[0].segments
 print(json.dumps({'lines':len(lines),'current_traced_bytes':current,'peak_traced_bytes':peak,'line_object_bytes':sys.getsizeof(lines[0]),'line_dict_bytes':sys.getsizeof(lines[0].__dict__) if hasattr(lines[0],'__dict__') else 0}))
